title: Stripe money-movement triage
summary: Find the method, establish the facts across payments, billing, disputes and balance, then let a person authorise any movement of money. Stripe exposes its whole API behind two generic tools, so the procedure — not the tool name — is what bounds this.

step_groups.title: Find the right method before calling anything.
step_groups.goal: Stripe's read and write tools accept any path. Establish the method from the API index rather than from memory, because a plausible wrong path returns a plausible wrong answer.

steps.title: Locate the API method.
steps.goal: Search the Stripe API for the resource this request is about and read the chosen method's parameters.

step_groups.title: Establish the facts, across every surface that bears on them.
step_groups.goal: What was paid, what it was billed for, whether it is disputed, and whether the balance can absorb a reversal.

steps.title: Read the charge and its existing refunds.
steps.goal: Establish the charge, its payment intent and any refund already issued against it.

steps.title: Read the invoice and subscription behind it.
steps.goal: Establish what the customer was billed for and whether the charge is part of a recurring arrangement.

steps.title: Read the dispute and the customer's history.
steps.goal: Establish the reason code, the evidence deadline and whether this customer has disputed before.

steps.title: Check the account can absorb it.
steps.goal: Establish the available balance before recommending money out of it.

step_groups.title: Move money only on a person's decision.
step_groups.goal: Issue exactly the refund a person approved, for the charge established above.

steps.title: Issue the approved refund.
steps.goal: One call, bound to the charge and amount a person saw and approved.
